name: Bonus Bunnies

features.name: Wild Expansion
features.description: Bunnies make wilds explode vertically or horizontally.

features.name: Carrot Link Spins
features.description: A three-spin collect round with resetting spins.

features.name: Enhancing bunnies
features.description: Upgrade the values during the link round.

review:
A cartoon 4x4 with an unusually soft maths model for Nolimit. When a bunny lands with a wild, the wild explodes vertically – and horizontally too if two bunnies land – turning one wild into a whole cross.

Three bonus bunnies start Carrot Link Spins: three spins that reset whenever a carrot or an enhancing bunny lands, while values build up. Medium volatility, 6,950x max and an 18% hit rate. Cheerful and slightly odd.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
